{{Quote|Senator Jubben. STATUS: Terminated. Baron Wazado. STATUS: Terminated. Senator Amidala. STATUS: ABORTABORTABORTABOR-|From the recovered log of [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] ASN-121|<ref name="NEGD" />}}
'''ASN-121''' was a hovering [[ASN courier droid/Legends|ASN courier droid]] similar in appearance to a [[Remote/Legends|remote]]. It could wield a number of weapons and was designed by the [[Malkite Poisoners]] to operate as an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]].

==Characteristics==
The droid included a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]], harpoon, sniper [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], gas dispenser, and various drills and cutters. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was capable of emitting disruptive energy beams, which allowed it to bypass security screens. Other implements, like spy sensors, could also be attached to the droid's modular frontal tool chuck. Powering the droid was a fusion reactor, which required a power converter array to mediate the energy flux. This converter array could also double as a self-defensive electroshock device. Though ostensibly a courier, the droid was actually an assassination model made by the [[Malkite Poisoners]]. They made one for the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] assassin [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] to serve as her personal [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]], used in an attempt to kill [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="NEGD" />

==History==
[[File:ASN121_ICS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|ASN-121 cross-section.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] used the droid in an attempt to assassinate [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who was residing in a senatorial apartment in a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] skyscraper. The droid cut a hole in the window of Amidala's chamber, and through this hole inserted a canister containing two [[Kouhun/Legends|kouhuns]].

When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sensed a disturbance in the room, they saved Padmé by slashing through the kouhuns using their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. In order to find out who sent ASN-121, Obi-Wan jumped through the window and grabbed the fleeing droid. It attempted to shake Kenobi off, but Wesell fired a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] and destroyed it, leaving Kenobi free-falling until he was saved by Anakin's appropriated [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]].
